name: Fig Mail
tagline: Gives your bot's email a proper webmail interface instead of a chat window.
description: Mail a bot receives usually ends up buried in a conversation, which is no way to run an inbox. Ask this one to set things up and it builds a tidy webmail interface in the style of a classic desktop mail app, points it at your bot's own address, and hosts the result, so bot mail gets read and filed like real mail.
author: krushalkalkani
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
